name: Feed
description: Publish the latest 24 hours of RSS articles as a host-rotated status-bar carousel. summary carries links and article previews; label is the headline alone, so the template owns the name, the colour, and the hover. cycle_interval defaults to 30 seconds. Configure url to enable fetching.

url.description: The RSS or Atom feed to read: an https URL without credentials, which Flash fetches for the plugin. No request runs until it is set.

cycle_interval.description: Seconds each headline stays in the carousel.
